LanguageData.EES_IntelData_T1Core.label: intel data (tier 1)
LanguageData.EES_IntelData_T1Core.description: An encrypted data core holding the layout, strength, and facilities of an enemy outpost. It allows remote scouting of low-tier (T1-T5) strongholds. Available only from exotic goods traders, and cannot be crafted.
LanguageData.EES_IntelData_T2Core.label: intel data (tier 2)
LanguageData.EES_IntelData_T2Core.description: A high-density encrypted data core holding the layout, strength, and facilities of an enemy outpost. It allows remote scouting of mid-tier (T1-T8) strongholds. Available only from exotic goods traders, and cannot be crafted.
LanguageData.EES_IntelData_T3Core.label: intel data (tier 3)
LanguageData.EES_IntelData_T3Core.description: A top-grade encrypted data core holding the layout, strength, and facilities of an enemy outpost. It allows remote scouting of even high-tier (T1-T12) strongholds. Only very rarely available from exotic goods traders, and cannot be crafted.
